notes.title: Patch Notes | Version 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Welcome to the Element Space Update 1.0.9!
In this update, we focused on adding some "Quality of Life" improvements to the game hoping to address some of the feedback we gathered from the community and ultimately make the game more enjoyable for everyone.

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][h1]No penalties for bailing on a mission. [/h1]
As many of you have requested, [b]missions can be abandoned to try another party setup without any penalties in Normal Mode.[/b] Extinction Mode remains as always, so if you are up for that challenge make sure to plan ahead!
[*][h1]New achievements [/h1]
We added new Achievements: one for each level finished with all combats on Perfect score, and one for having unlocked all the Perfect Level achievements. 
[*][h1]Character Previews[/h1]
Whenever you gain a character for your squad and add it for the first time to the party, you will be shown a short video preview of what this new character can do.  Also, this video can be triggered anytime from the Skill & Perks screen pressing the newly added button "Review" next to the character portrait.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33281965/c5f047c030ca45c92b8dc7682f49989df6cdb4cc.gif[/img]
[*][h1]Character re-specs [/h1]
Not happy with how you spent your perk points? You can now reset them and try a new build as many times as you want. We added a new "Reset" button to the Skill & Perks screen to allow this.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33281965/3091480a5498722ff8c8df94ca8eb0c954d2e130.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Feedback Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Icons with tooltips for passive enemy effects and special abilities to their nameplates. This should help avoid nasty surprises.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33281965/abf19a4fc3238622fbf2360dfa17011fb0fdae17.gif[/img]
[*]Savefiles are now properly sorted by last played. In addition, we added the name of the mission in which the game was saved.
[*]Added feedback on dialogue choices to showcase how it impacted your standings.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33281965/3a8c0e6aebeae9011b64a1f2ae39f2390d4bbe83.gif[/img]
[*]Removed continue button from the main menu. You can now select your saved games or start a new game inside a single menu.
[*]Revised the difficulty for problematic missions. I'm looking at you, Maria...
[*]Improved the spawn of enemy waves so they don't appear and attack in the same turn, allowing the player to react and run for cover.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33281965/2009e905840277c2211fd9e8402d3d40e6b3a18f.gif[/img]
[*]Added on-screen notifications when the Ideology alignment or relation with a faction/companion changed
[/list]

[h1]Tweaks:[/h1]
[list]
[*]MSRM Story mission, last combat: added two more turns to get perfect.
[*]CSAC Story mission: Changed the flamethrower specialist for a grunt at the last combat.
[*]CSAC Story mission: Changed Maria's AI to allow her to avoid grenades and better target her skills.
[*]CSAC Story mission: Removed Maria's shield and added more HP.
[*]Historian Loyalty mission: tweaked waves spawn conditions to avoid the waves to be triggered during the player's turn.
[*]CSAC scientists are now unaffected by the CSAC faction perk.
[*]Fixed A LOT OF cover positions to avoid line of sight problems on the following missions: Tutorial, MSRM Story, MSRM Resources, CSAC Story, CSAC Resources, FNAS Resources, Arthur Loyalty, Jack Loyalty, EBD Resources and Mid Boss.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed lock at ES story mission triggered by a certain combination of responses on the last cutscene.
[*]Fixed lock on the after mission debriefing screen when missions were played in a very specific order.
[*]Fixed enemies affected with Soul Possession not unspawning when the phase changes to the Final Combat.
[*]Fixed tutorial "Click to move/attack" text not being localized to Chinese.
[*]Fixed savegame names not being localized.
[*]Fixed Area abilities message "Target an Area" not being localized.
[*]Fixed "Sprint" popup text not being localized.
[*]Fixed character clipping to a wall at the EBD Story mission.
[*]Fixed Controls menu in the Options screen not being localized to Chinese.
[*]Fixed some popup windows not blocking input on the background.
[*]Fixed savegames accumulating trash data.
[*]Fixed achievement "Welcome to the Gun Show" triggering before time.
[*]Fixed Jun's skirt physics bug.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]We found a possible bug in the dynamic font of Unity causing the rendering of mistaken characters for the Russian language
[/list]

Once again, a big [b]Thank You[/b] to all the community for being so active and sending us so many great ideas, suggestions, and bug reports to improve Element: Space. We are truly happy to see you guys enjoying the game and we'll give our best to keep making it even better ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Last chance to get Element: Space at a launch price!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

[h1]Don’t miss the chance to get the game at its early access price.[/h1]

The launch discount promotion ends on March 15th, before going up to its release price of USD 24.99

We also wanted to use this opportunity to give you a preview of what’s coming on next week's update.


[h1] PATCH PREVIEW [/h1]


[h1] - No penalties for bailing on a mission. [/h1]

As many of you have requested, [b]missions can be abandoned to try another party without any penalties in Story Mode.[/b]


[h1] - New achievements [/h1]

We added new Achievements: one for each level finished with all its combats perfect, and one for having unlocked all the level perfect achievements. 


[h1]- Character Previews[/h1]

Whenever you gain a character for your squad, you will be shown a short video preview of what this new character can do. 


[h1]- Character respecs [/h1]

Not happy with how you spent your perk points? You can now reset them and try a new build.


[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]


- Added Icons with tooltips for passive enemy effects and special abilities to their nameplates. This should help avoid nasty surprises.

- Savefiles are now properly sorted by last played. In addition, we added the name of the level in which the game was saved.

- Added feedback on dialogue choices to reflect how it impacted your standings.

- Removed continue button from the main menu. You can now select your saved games or start a new game inside a single menu.

- Revised the difficulty for problematic levels. I’m looking at you, Maria...

- Many tweaks and bug fixes to improve the game experience.

notes.title: Release Notes & Thoughts
notes.content:
[h1]Hello players! We wanted to take a minute of your time and talk about Element:Space a bit. 
It is our first game as an indie studio, so we are very thankful to all of you who have been following us and playing it. Thanks you so much![/h1]

[h1]We will continue improving the game[/h1]

When we started making Element: Space we wanted to make a game with its own identity. Our source material includes a series of characters with incredible abilities, which immediately drew us in to create a game based on the use of these skills and their interactions. 

We recognise there’s room for improvement to better bring to light what we see and love about our game, so that you can experience it too.

Our commitment to making Element: Space the best it can be is a [b]fact.[/b]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]

We are mainly working on bugs reported by you, new ones that had not appeared in our QA supplier reviews or even by in our internal QA department. We will be making continuous fixes that will be reflected progressively in upcoming upgrades.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

The Early Access helped us a lot to improve the gaming experience, but there is still work to be done! Based on the community comments and reviews, the Sixth Vowel team is working non-stop on several features and we will be informing you real soon about the solutions we will be working on.

Our improvements will focus mainly on [b]better feedback[/b] and[b] clear information[/b], so that you can engage in combat and levels with all the tools to make better strategic decisions. Another major focus is [b]usability[/b] which can be always improved.

[h1]Fixes and Updates:[/h1]

[b]Upcoming Updates[/b]
[list][*] We are improving in-mission [b]enemy ability signaling[/b] so it's harder to get caught unprepared.
[*] We will be improving[b] briefing information[/b] in the galaxy map, so you can better plan your team composition. This will include better intel on [b]Faction Perks[/b] and how they work.
[*] We are cleaning up the [b]save/load UX[/b] flow to make it smoother.
[*] After a character is unlocked you will receive a short preview of their abilities, so you can get a feel of what they do without being forced to try them out.
[*] In story mode, you will be able to restart a mission (not battles) with a new party without penalties. If a party isn't really working you can change it and try again.
[/list]

[b]Fixes Done in this quick patch[/b]

[list][*] Ship Conversation between The Historian and Alice at the ship was fixed.
[*] “Soul Possession” is now working for the SU soldiers (tough guys!) in all combats.
[*] Fixed the movement bugs in the “Kingdom of Heaven” story mission.
[*] Several un-localized content was found and some old localization content was updated.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes Underway[/h1]
[list]
[*] We still have several localization issues that will be solved in the next update.
[*] We are fixing some oddball situations in which enemies seem to be shooting in between walls.
[*] We are checking the entire saving mechanic as we received several warnings from the community.
[*] An important blocker found during the Big Finale combat on very specific occasions.
[*] A minor blocker during Epilogues on specific occasions.
[/list]

We hope you have a great time playing the game and remember we are always craving for positive reviews ːsteamhappyː

Spread the word and plan your turn!

notes.title: Element: Space | Release day
notes.content:
[h1]We are very happy today...we have finally launched the game! Wow! 
We’ll keep an eye to the community’s feedback (it means a lot to us!) and making official announcements on relevant issues.
[/h1]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed attacks going through the fountain in KOH
[*] CSAC : Fixed Combat 4 Dialogue
[*] MSRM : Fixed Mission objective not shown correctly
[*] Soul Possession : Fixed Possesed Enemies have proper description
[*] MSRM : Fixed secondary objectives without localization
[*] MSRM : Fixed Enemy not moving in third combat
[*] SU : Fixed Alice Clipping with enemy after using earth dash
[*] EBD : Fixed Softlock when using Earth Dash on a Turret
[*] Fixed SU Cutscene
[*] Fixed Two Handed Sword Mk III - Reward tooltip content
[*] Fixed Call Starkill to talk blocked in final phase
[*] ES Fixed Starkill does not appear if we skip the cutscene
[*] SU Fixed Camera can be moved during conversation
[*] MSRM : Fixed texture behind wall
[*] MAIN MENU: Fixed disable Tutorial screen not localized properly
[*] Fixed Command level 4 not having AOE
[*] Fixed Shotgun MK I softlocks
[*] Fixed Saved games not saving mission aid data
[*] Fixed Captain spawning with a blue tint when loading checkpoints
[*] Fixed block after trying to attack with starkill
[*] Fixed Maria abilities cooldowns at Tier3
[*] Fixed turret activation even if it was destroyed
[*] KOH: Fixed Swordman enemy dash outside of battleground
[/list]

[h1]Release version[/h1]
The current version is v1.0.2, the previous one was v0.064. Don’t be scared! This is due to an internal matter. If you updated the game in the last few hours today, you have the final version.

[h1]What happens if I bought the game in Early Access with my game session?[/h1]
At the end of the game in Early Access a pop-up was shown which announced the end of the Early Access. We just updated the version (we take off that pop-up) to avoid misunderstandings. You can go on playing that game’s session you’ve being playing in Early Access.

[h1]Forum[/h1]
In these days the activity in the forum grew a lot. We decided to organize it better. Remember that we are always here to listen and discuss the game. We will be creating more categories as specific issues become relevant.

[b]Bug Reporting[/b]
For those who buy the game: report bugs that our internal QA team will be reviewing constantly.
 
[b]Game Mechanics Q&A[/b]
Doubts about game mechanics and tips/hints between players.

[h1]Replayability? Why?[/h1]
The game has 3 possible endings and epilogues, according to the decisions you make and the characters you unblock.
Each squad you create will have different types of combos to beat the enemy.
For each playthrough, you can unlock Zero, Alice and 3 additional characters. (Remember that we have a total of 8 characters!)

We want to thank to those who are participating in the community. We welcome those who recently choose to enter this Sci-Fi world we’ve created.
We hope you have a great time playing the game and remember we are always craving for positive reviews ːsteamhappyː

[i][b]Spread the word and plan your turn![/b][/i]

notes.title: Element Space | Announcement | Tuesday
notes.content:
[h1]Enhancements:[/h1]
Balanced an enemy wave in the CSAC’s resource mission to make it less punishing.

[h1]Fixed Bugs:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some cover slots were missing in the Tutorial Mission.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented objectives from appearing after Tutorial Combat 3.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the Game Over screen from being displayed after losing through dialogue in the ES story mission.
[*] Fixed the mine explosion SFX that kept playing after combat ended.
[*] Added passive feedback for when Fan the Hammer is activated.
[*] Improved dialogue jumps when interacting with the generator in the CSAC Story Mission.
[*] The EBD Side Shields perk is now working correctly after Melee Lock.
[*] The Trickshot SFX has been fixed.
[*] Improved the MidBoss Combat.
[*] Fixed a Grappling Hook issue where Christopher sometimes went back to his previous cover after use.
[*] Fixed SFX: Tank Armor triggers. 
[*] Ammo is displayed correctly in the UI.
[*] The gaps on the bridges between the ships in the MSRM Story Mission now function as “out of bounds” spaces.
[*] Fixed: ES Specialist Sword visibility.
[*] Fixed: Out of bounds Cover Nodes.
[/list]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[b]Localization: [/b]The first translations of the game have arrived and are being integrated into the project. We are working to have language support for Spanish, French, German, Russian, and Chinese available soon.
We are still testing the functionality of [b]Mission Aids and New Weapons[/b] in combat. We’re almost there!

[h1]Backlog List[/h1]

[b]Buffs & Debuffs[/b]
We've been working on a standardization pass on buff and debuff timer expirations.

Right now, buff and debuff duration is tracked only through the player's turn. This has lead to various inconsistencies.
 
In the future, buff and debuff duration will start counting turns from the moment the buff or debuff’s effects are applied, ticking up whenever it’s time for its caster to act again.
 
For example, say Maria uses her “Share the Pain” skill on an enemy. This debuff’s effect lasts for one turn. This means that after being cast it last for the remaining duration of Maria’s turn, the entirety of the enemy’s turn, and expires on Maria’s next turn.
 
[b]Companion Missions[/b]
 
We just wrapped up all companion missions and delivered them to our QA team for testing!

Companion missions become available when you develop enough trust and reputation with a given companion. They are special story missions that serve as the climax of the companions’ personal story arcs. Helping them complete these missions will earn you their loyalty, unlocking a unique combat perk and a final ship conversation with them.

[b]High-Tier Perks and Skills[/b]
 
We have finished balancing and testing the game’s top-tier perks. In the final release of the game you will be able to go full super-saiyan without fear of the game exploding.
 
[b]Endings[/b]
 
Work has been completed on the game’s various endings and epilogues. These are variations of the game’s closing scenes and of the final political panorama of the Galaxy, all dependent on the many choices you made throughout the game.
 
Keep in mind that these are variations in the direction and details of a central conclusion, so don’t expect Christopher to save the Galaxy in one ending and to open up a flower shop in another. Still, we can proudly say that the payoff won’t be one of three different colored explosions.
 
 
[b]Special Final Boss Stage[/b]
 
Speaking of endings, we’ve also tied up the game’s final battle. Boy, if you thought the game was hard, you haven’t seen anything yet! This battle will test your mastery of all the game’s combat systems while still providing a good amount of breadth for you to approach it with different tactics, styles, and party compositions, making your victory truly your own.

notes.title: Q&A
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, we’d like to thank you. We are humbled with such a passionate reception.
For our first Q&A, we took a bit more time to gather enough data to plan out our course of action.
From now onwards, we will try to answer your concerns as soon as possible.

[h1]Checkpoints, Saving & Heals:[/h1]
On our internal tests, levels took significantly less time to complete. So we didn't feel the need to have many exit points. Now that the game is out, in real player hands, we realize that might not be the case.

We agree that not being able to take breaks when you don't have a lot of time to play isn't great. Having to replay through a whole level, just to get another chance at the last encounter doesn't feel right, either.

The answer is not as simple as restoring your health after every encounter. That won't be any help if you were doing great, and you failed at the last encounter. You will still have to run through the whole level. 
 
Although we are not ready to announce specifics, we are taking steps to fix this issue. We don't want to make any rushed decisions which could hurt the game in other ways.

[h1]Hit chance percentages:[/h1]
You guys wanted to know the reasoning behind these design choices. 

Element Space isn't a game just about shooting people behind boxes. Other games have already covered that out pretty well, so we wanted to double down on what makes Element Space special, which is using (and abusing) character skills and party composition to great effect.

Instead of having a complex aiming system that might give the wrong impression that going in guns blazing will get you far, we decided to streamline it to its fundamentals.:
[list]
[*] If there’s a big object between your squaddie and its target, then you will hit the object instead.
[*] If there’s a small object between your squaddie and its target, then there's a 50-50 chance.
[*] If there's nothing, well, you earned that shot!
[/list]
This system makes the battlefield easier to read at glance, and has the added benefit of driving home the necessity to reposition.
Hiding behind boxes isn't a place for action heroes. That's why we built a lot of movement options, and we don't have a "mana" system to restrict their usage.

The data we gathered this week show us a strong correlation between skill usage frequency and combat success rate.
That been said, we are talking some measures to make sure new players interact with the game the way we meant.

[h1]Melee Lock and Cover nodes:[/h1]
We’ve read there is some confusion on to how melee interacts with cover.
[list]
[*] When 2 units clash in melee lock, they are no longer considered in cover.
[*] Other units have a 50% chance to miss shots at melee locked units.
[*] If a unit is freed from the lock it will automatically enter cover if it’s standing on top of a cover node.
[*] Line-of-sight rules still apply. Meaning that if there’s a large object in between shooter and melee locked target, the shot will hit the object.
[/list]
If any these rules fail to apply, that's a bug!

[h1]Combat start positioning: [/h1]
Encounters are meant to be a puzzle to be solved.
You are presented with a situation that you need to get through with the team that you selected.
Being able to choose your start location it's something we experimented with. 
Ultimately we ended up cutting it because they increased the scope way too much to give them proper support.

[h1]Story:[/h1]
Element Space is a branching storyline! The missions that pop up by relating to other companions (loyalty missions) are being developed and will be included in the final release. Although relationships between characters are deep in Element Space’s storyline, there is no romance… yet. 

[h1]Localization, Character Creation & Voice Over:[/h1]
For those concerned about the game being available in other languages, yes, localization is in the pipeline. We are still debating which languages 

For our first game, we wanted to focus and fully flesh out on Christopher Pietham's story.

Here is an active [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/887370/discussions/0/1760230437362661573/]thread[/url] with our thoughts, on the subject.
Having a prebuilt character set allows us to full voice over for every single one of them. 
Yes, voice-overs are coming.

[h1]General Feedback:[/h1]
We are reading all the feedback and bug report you are posting. 
There are some really interesting suggestions and issues we agree with and we are working to make improvements (Overwatch preview cone, key bindings, hacking turrets, to name a few). 
Please keep in mind that, even we consider all feedback equally, not all of them will make into the game.

For those concerned about ultra-wide screens, we won't be providing support for 21:9 as a game resolution, since it's beyond our scope.
But if you run into any trouble (ie: stretching, crashes...) running the game in such monitors, please, let us know.

[h1]Bug Reports:[/h1]
Lastly, every reported bug has been added to our backlog (QA guys say thank you!). 

We are opening a new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/887370/discussions/0/1742226629879121724/]thread[/url] to concentrate our bug squashing efforts for you to Please try to post your new catches here.


On behalf of the whole team: Thank you for your feedback. Your support means the world to us!!!

notes.title: Release Notes 0.0.44 | Element Space | Early Access Launch
notes.content:
[h1] Release Notes 0.0.44 [/h1]

[b]List of known issues:[/b]

[u][b]Critical errors:[/b][/u]
- There could be a problem with the AutoSave Feature if you go back to the Main Menu during a mission, you may lose some of the latest progress you've made. It almost never happens, but in case it does, do let us know, we'll attempt to fix it asap as soon as we discover the cause. 
- The Mars mission, “Foul Deeds Will Rise”, may fail to start sometimes, in this case closing the application and attempting to play the mission again will most likely fix the issue. If it doesn't, please restart the application again and select another mission.  
- Very rarely, after an enemy of the CSAC faction throws a grenade, the floor can change color and afterwards the renderer may stop working. In this case, there is no option but to restart the application.
- On some very rare scenarios, when an Overwatch triggers, there is a very low chance that the game could appear to have frozen. If it does not unfreeze itself in 10 seconds, it means the game softlocked. On these cases, restarting the application is the only solution.
- If you use Maria’s skill ‘Share the Pain’ with the MSRM Specialist in range (the unit that casts ‘Pain Reflect’) within the Republic’s Secondary mission, the game may freeze. Unfortunately, restarting the application is the only solution.
[u][b]
Performance:[/b][/u]
- You may encounter some performance problems on some specific areas of some specific missions, we are still working on optimization, we apologize for any inconveniences this could cause.

[b][u]Gameplay:[/u][/b]
- On some rare scenarios, attacking with Ranged Weapons in Melee Lock may cause an unwanted movement before the attack.
- Some Achievements may fail to unlock when the conditions are met. Achievements will be working properly for the Full Release of the game.
- Clicking on the Weapon Panel HUD to switch weapons may not always respond to input. Moving the mouse away from the HUD and going back on it and clicking again near the icon of the weapon will most likely fix the issue.
- Some turrets on the Directorate's level may fail to activate even when the right amount of turns have passed.
- The HUD marker that highlights affected units with AoE skills is not big enough and could go by unnoticed.
- When landing critical hits, the Damage counter may fail to appear to alert that the attack landed more damage than what was predicted. if you deal more damage than the prediction says, it means it was a Critical Hit.
- Melee Lock may occasionally not work as intended and fail to lock the opponent. 

[b][u]Camera:[/u][/b]
- When the action camera triggers, it will sometimes move inside an object or wall and block sight of the action.
- Using the Skip Cutscene function will sometimes fail to put the camera back to the correct position for the rest of the cutscene, but it will go back to working correctly once it's over or a combat starts.
- During events that occur mid-fight, the camera may fail to make walls and obstacles disappear, effectively blocking sight of the action. This depends on what direction the camera was pointing at when the event triggered.
[b][u]
Sound and Music:[/u][/b]
- No gunshot SFX is observed when enemy shoots at the player characters just before the 1st combat of the Tutorial.
- When fighting on Truce for the second time, the battle music may fail to play properly.
- There are some SFX's that may fail to trigger, like when rounds bounce off the Tank in the Union's mission and the preparation sounds of some enemy skills.
- Some ambient SFXs may still be heard after putting the Sound option to volume 0. If you wish the application to be completely muted, you can use the OS volume mixer until we fix the issue.

notes.title: MSRM | FACTION
notes.content:
Hi all,

We want to share with you a little bit more about Element Space's lore.

[h1]MOST SERENE REPUBLIC OF THE MEDITERRANEAN - MSRM[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33281965/3a95c73fb13aed1ec51c382e700e18e7711fda54.png[/img]

The [b]MSRM[/b] is best known for its development of ocean planets and appreciation for the cultures of Byzantium and ancient Greece. The MSRM stresses work-life balance and technological advancement.

"As the landing shuttle descends through the atmosphere of Venus, all you can see far below you is the immensity of the ocean, stretching on towards the horizon. Your destination is Thermopylae, capital of The Most Serene Republic of the Mediterranean, a great, sprawling city that sails across the waves."
